title: Quick questions before I design this
lede: This is the home page for The Ambiguity Project, a non-profit with a new book (Ambiguity Everywhere), a Substack blog, a few tools, and a way to sign up or donate. You already have a navy, ivory and salmon design for it.

questions.title: How far from your current design should I go?
questions.why: Your plans say to carry the current page design over as-is, so I want to know if you're after small refinements or new ideas.

options.label: Refine the current look
options.detail: Same navy, ivory and salmon, with better layouts and details

options.label: A mix
options.detail: A couple close to today's design, the rest new directions

options.label: Start fresh
options.detail: New directions, keeping only the logo and the book

questions.title: What should a first-time visitor notice first?
questions.why: Right now the page opens on the mission and a quote, and the book comes second.

questions.title: What should it feel like?
questions.why: Ambiguity is a serious subject, but the book cover is playful with its puzzle pieces. I'd like to know where you want to land between those.
questions.textPlaceholder: e.g. Like a good university press, but warmer

questions.title: Which color should lead?
questions.why: These are the colors already in your logo, mockup and book cover.

questions.title: How many directions should I design?
questions.why: More directions give you more range to compare. Fewer are quicker to compare.

questions.title: Anything else I should know?
questions.why: Optional. Sites you admire, things you dislike in the current design, and so on.
questions.placeholder: e.g. I like how the book cover tilts
